body:
she was 22, and by her own telling, it was the best year of her life so far — not because everything was easy, but because for once she let herself be in the middle of figuring it out instead of pretending to have it together.

that's the actual spirit behind "22." people remember it as a party song. what's really in there is closer to a love letter, written to the specific friends who were in the mess right alongside her.

the photo here is Taylor bringing that same red era back to a stadium full of us, over a decade later — different room, same friendship-first energy the song was always about.

the story behind "22": longlivets.com/?item=vault-red-22-a-birthday-letter-to-her-closest-friends&utm_source=instagram&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=track-fact
